New York: U.S. Customs seized 200 counterfeit Cartier watches at Chicago O'Hare, carrying a combined $28 million retail price had they been genuine.

CBP pulled two parcels moving from Hong Kong to California on 18 September. Its Centers of Excellence and Expertise ruled the watches counterfeit for bearing Cartier's registered trademarks.

Full story on caratcapital.org, link in bio.
